name: @aegora/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for the DDD codegen starter (common + identity sample)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle events --output src/.bundled/events.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle events --output src/.bundled/events.json && redocly bundle offers --output src/.bundled/offers.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle offers --output src/.bundled/offers.json && redocly bundle alerts --output src/.bundled/alerts.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle alerts --output src/.bundled/alerts.json && redocly bundle holds --output src/.bundled/holds.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle holds --output src/.bundled/holds.json && redocly bundle cases --output src/.bundled/cases.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle cases --output src/.bundled/cases.json && redocly bundle policies --output src/.bundled/policies.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle policies --output src/.bundled/policies.json && redocly bundle models --output src/.bundled/models.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle models --output src/.bundled/models.json && redocly bundle audits --output src/.bundled/audits.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle audits --output src/.bundled/audits.json
